Calculation of Direct Costs and Adjustments.  The Direct Costs have been pre-calculated by Landlord, and agreed to by Tenant, as being a fair and accurate representation of the expenses set forth in Section 6.1.  The Direct Costs shall be fixed during the term of this Lease, unless and until Landlord provides Tenant with written notice of a change in the Direct Costs due to changes in the expenses set forth in Section 6.1. If the Direct Costs increase during the Lease Term, Landlord shall provide Tenant with an itemization of the new Direct Costs, and the prorata amount of the new Direct Cost to be paid by Tenant to Landlord.  The new amount of the Direct Costs shall then be applicable as of the first day of the month following Landlord’s notice.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, the aggregate amount of the Direct Costs payable by Tenant shall not increase by more than four percent (4%) in any calendar year over the amount payable in the immediately preceding calendar year, on a non-cumulative and non-compounding basis.  Landlord shall deliver to Tenant, within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each calendar year, an itemized statement of the Direct Costs actually incurred for that year, together with reasonable supporting documentation.  Tenant may, not more than once in any calendar year and within one hundred eighty (180) days after receipt of such statement, audit Landlord’s books and records relating to the Direct Costs, at Tenant’s cost and expense; provided, however, that if such audit discloses an overstatement of the Direct Costs exceeding four percent (4%), Landlord shall pay the reasonable cost of the audit and shall credit the overstated amount against the next installments of the Direct Costs payable by Tenant.  Tenant’s right to audit shall not be conditioned upon Tenant not being in default under this Lease.
